answer: Seat jurors by bonding a stake; pay them from the emission pool only when their 0-3 verdict matches the sealed panel median, and salt each panel with hidden honeypots. Pass a canary or drift from that median and the stake is slashed. A collusion ring is a plume of correlated votes the random jury draw scatters, and every captured seat risks its capital on a reef of canaries, so one honest grader's ember of dissent prices out the cartel. Forcing a verdict needs a supermajority of a random jury with each seat separately bonded: cost = bond x seats x P(honeypot), so a thousand fakes buy nothing.
